messages:
Sam W: Heads up — running a pre-launch compatibility sweep with Snowflake ingestion team + Databricks runtime folks tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need quick answers on schema mapping, streaming adapter backpressure behavior, and vector DB ingest idempotency. Who can join?
Priya K: I can make 10am. Can you add a short agenda? Ideally confirm the sample data shape and failure modes.
Diego R: I'll join. Quick note: the Databricks connector has a new opt-in backpressure flag (enable_rate_limit). If we enable it, throughput drops ~20% in perf tests.
Elena M: tagging the Snowflake eng contact @Jasmine P to confirm COPY INTO behavior for our parquet->table flow.
Jasmine P: thanks @Elena M — Snowflake side: COPY INTO respects schema evolution for nullable fields but will error on missing partition columns. We'll bring a matrix of allowed schemas.
Sam W: agenda draft:
- sample datasets + schema matrix
- streaming vs batch fallback behavior
- vector DB ingest idempotency & dedupe approach
- marketplace listing compliance (privacy/entitlements)
- launch PR/press sync

Sam W: also need to validate streaming adapter logs for backpressure. Diego, can you paste the failing log snippet we saw?
Diego R: sure, here's the one from last soak:
```
2026-02-12T16:42:11Z [stream-adapter] WARN backpressure: queue_depth=512 threshold=500 drop=false
2026-02-12T16:42:12Z [connector] ERROR commit_failed: txn_id=0x7f3e, cause=duplicate_record
```
Priya K: note on idempotency: vector DB upserts can be done via idempotent ids, but not all partner DBs support batching with dedupe. Need to list per-vector-db behavior (Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone).
Elena M: for the marketplace listing: legal needs the dataflow diagram + KMS usage note. I'll loop in legal after the technical sync.
Jasmine P: can we block 15 minutes after the sync for a short GTM/press run through? We need to confirm the joint announcement timeline.
Sam W: perfect. Meeting invite sent to this thread. @marketplace-bot: attach the latest listing checklist.
marketplace-bot: attached: /assets/marketplace_checklist_v2.pdf :white_check_mark:
Priya K: prework: upload small sample dataset to the shared S3 bucket and post link here.
Diego R: s3://redwood-partner-tests/snow-dbx/sample-parquet-v3/
Sam W: thanks. See you all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
